explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. I grepped Mathlib for `coalgHom_ext` and `CoalgHom.*ext`. The only hits were the generic `CoalgHom.ext` uses in `Coalgebra/Hom.lean` and `Coalgebra/Equiv.lean`. I also read `Mathlib/RingTheory/Coalgebra/MonoidAlgebra.lean`. It gives the coalgebra instance on `A[X]`, `counit_single` and `comul_single`, but no ext lemma for coalgebra homomorphisms out of `R[G]`. `Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra` has no coalgebra material. The library's proof uses `lhom_ext'`, `LinearMap.ext_ring` and `CoalgHom.coe_linearMap_injective`. Together these are more than a one-or-two-line derivation from a single Mathlib declaration.
